title: How father started on drums; funerals and cabarets
summary: Father picked up drums as a young boy and played funerals and red-light district cabarets, bass drum in marching bands.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Getting my first drums, with or without lessons

blocks.x: To get back to your father, did he ever tell you anything about when he started in music or how he got started? Well he started, he picked that up when he was a young kid.

When he was a very young kid he picked up drums. And he played all in the red light district and all those cabarets and different places like that. He played a lot of funerals. Different funerals, you know people dying, they used to have those bands behind them. Well he played a lot of that. That was one of his biggest jobs, that and cabarets.
Did he usually like to play a snare drum or the bass drum in those marching bands?

In the marching bands he always did play the bass drum. Yeah he used to like hit the four raps on those fellas. Yeah he used to play the bass drum in the funerals but in the cabarets he played both, you know the combination. Then he had a friend, I think you might have heard of his friend, Cantrell. Oh yes, Louis Cantrell.
